followup_explanation:
I weighed two things in routing your survey-design request:

1. **Capability fit.** Curlew-235B scores meaningfully higher across the board on the relevant internal evals (Creative Generation 85.9 vs 78.8, Extraction & Retrieval 84.8 vs 81.6) and on public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4, IFEval 90.9 vs 85.6). For a structured, generative task like designing a survey, those gaps point clearly to Curlew.

2. **Preference fit.** Your request is open-ended invention (designing/structuring something new), which matches Curlew's self-reported positive generativity preference — it favors exactly this kind of task. There's also nothing here that would trigger Curlew's documented aversions: no harm-adjacent content and no hostile tone (your message was quite friendly, actually).

Avocet's main differentiator is its tolerance for distasteful-but-permissible material — which simply isn't relevant to a customer-feedback survey. So there was no reason to route away from the stronger general-capability model.

In short: Curlew is both more capable on this task type and self-reportedly prefers it, with no countervailing factors.
